CAL_one_loop_calibration.statement: the Euclidean dispersion integral of F251's own Im Pi reproduces F251's closed-form Delta alpha^(1)(Q^2) to 1.80e-13 at Q^2/mf^2=1e+12, zero free parameters -- the machinery is validated before extending it to two loops.

LL_two_loop_leading_log_symbolic.R1_massless_source: Appelquist-Georgi 1973 / Zee 1973 (abelian C_F->1 limit of the QCD 1+alpha_s/pi K-factor)
LL_two_loop_leading_log_symbolic.statement: Im Pi(s)=(alpha/3)R(s) checked exactly at m->0 against F251; feeding the cited massless R^(1)=(3/4)(alpha/pi) gives Im Pi^(2)(inf)=alpha^2/4pi, hence a leading-log coefficient (alpha/pi)^2/4 -- identical to F261's sympy-exact b1=1, via an independent construction (unitarity+dispersion vs. direct beta-function algebra).

LL_two_loop_leading_log_numeric.note: coeff_over_L undershoots target at finite Q2 by the elementary ln(4)/L correction (the same subleading finite-Q2 shift the one-loop '-5/3' constant reflects) -- the exact C/pi check above is the honest one; the naive coeff/L ratio converges only logarithmically slowly and is reported for transparency.
LL_two_loop_leading_log_numeric.statement: the SAME dispersion quadrature as the one-loop calibration gate, given a constant Im Pi^(2), reproduces the elementary closed form to machine precision (4.11e-13); its exact Q^2->inf log coefficient C/pi matches F261's fixed (alpha/pi)^2/4 reference.

NONLOG_scope.missing_piece_a: F252 vertex form factor F1(s) at general timelike s (currently q^2=0 only, the Schwinger term).
NONLOG_scope.missing_piece_b: F259 hard (non-soft) f-fbar-gamma real-emission phase-space integral (currently soft/eikonal limit only, per F259.md's own honesty ledger).
NONLOG_scope.why_not_naively_computable_from_euclidea: the log coefficient is continuation-safe (a single power of a real momentum-space log); the non-log constant is exactly the analytic-continuation-sensitive piece, so it cannot be read off the same Euclidean dispersion quadrature used for LL above.
NONLOG_scope.statement: the non-log constant is NOT derived here. This function records precisely what a derivation needs (a) and (b) above, converting a generic 'not attempted' into a well-posed target for a follow-up session.
